enabled.description: True turns realtime on for the cohort and for every realtime cohort it includes as criteria, and starts preparing them from past events. PostHog refuses that when the project's plan allows no more cohorts with realtime on, or when the criteria look back further than the plan allows. True for a cohort that is already on, and that nothing is preparing, asks PostHog to prepare it again. False turns realtime off. PostHog refuses that while a feature flag, an active workflow, or another cohort with realtime on reads the cohort.

id.description: A unique integer value identifying this cohort.
